private-readiness-life-planning.title: Private Readiness & Life Planning
private-readiness-life-planning.description: Confidential support for individuals and families navigating serious legal disruption. We help clients organize important responsibilities, identify priorities, and create structured plans for the life circumstances surrounding their situation.
private-readiness-life-planning.audience: Individuals and families facing serious legal disruption or major life transitions.

family-household-stability.title: Family & Household Stability
family-household-stability.description: Supporting spouses, partners, children, and families through major life transitions. Our services focus on household organization, family responsibilities, communication preparation, and maintaining stability during uncertain times.
family-household-stability.audience: Spouses, partners, caregivers, and families preparing for a major transition.

financial-stability.title: Financial Stability
financial-stability.description: Helping individuals and families organize financial responsibilities, important documents, household obligations, and continuity plans during periods of disruption. This service focuses on organization and preparedness, not financial advice or credit repair.
financial-stability.audience: Individuals and households managing financial responsibilities during disruption.

business-career-continuity.title: Business & Career Continuity
business-career-continuity.description: Structured readiness support for business owners, entrepreneurs, executives, and working professionals. We help organize business responsibilities, operational continuity plans, employment transitions, and important business information.
business-career-continuity.audience: Business owners, entrepreneurs, executives, and working professionals.

reputation-digital-presence.title: Reputation & Digital Presence
reputation-digital-presence.description: Private support for individuals and professionals seeking to organize their digital presence, prepare for reputation-related challenges, and develop responsible personal or professional rebuilding plans.
reputation-digital-presence.audience: Individuals and professionals managing personal or business reputation concerns.
reputation-digital-presence.note: We do not guarantee content removal or reputation restoration, and we do not use deceptive or unlawful tactics.

personal-reputation-readiness.title: Personal Reputation Readiness
personal-reputation-readiness.description: Digital footprint organization, online profile assessment, and communication preparedness.

executive-reputation-business-continuity.title: Executive Reputation & Business Continuity
executive-reputation-business-continuity.description: Premium, customized support for physicians, executives, business owners, founders, and other professionals managing complex business and reputation-related challenges.

federal-prison-readiness.title: Federal & Prison Readiness
federal-prison-readiness.description: Non-legal preparation and life-stability support for individuals and families navigating incarceration-related transitions. Services include personal document organization, family readiness, household transition planning, and practical preparation resources.
federal-prison-readiness.audience: Individuals and families preparing for incarceration-related transitions.

productive-time-planning.title: Productive-Time Planning
productive-time-planning.description: Helping individuals establish meaningful personal development goals, educational priorities, family connection plans, and structured routines during periods of disruption.
productive-time-planning.audience: Individuals seeking purposeful use of time during major transitions.

release-reentry-preparation.title: Release & Reentry Preparation
release-reentry-preparation.description: Life-stability planning for individuals and families preparing for the transition back into the community. Support includes housing readiness, employment preparation, family reunification planning, personal document organization, and resource navigation.
release-reentry-preparation.audience: Individuals preparing for reentry and the people supporting them.

90-day-ongoing-support.title: 90-Day & Ongoing Support
90-day-ongoing-support.description: Extended planning, accountability, and continuity support for clients who need structured assistance implementing their readiness plans over time.
90-day-ongoing-support.audience: Clients who need extended structured support as they put their readiness plans into practice.
